seriesTitle: The Duke's Son Claims He Won't Love Me, But Showers Me with Adoration

episodes.title: A Marriage Just for Show
episodes.summary: Elsa, the daughter of an impoverished noble family, receives a letter of marriage proposal from Julius, the eldest son of the ducal house of Royas. Though she is bewildered by the offer, she accepts for the sake of her family. However, after meeting the handsome Julius for the first time on their wedding day, he coldly declares to her, "I have absolutely no intention of ever loving you."

episodes.title: ...Thank You
episodes.summary: Even after hearing that her marriage is in name only, Elsa interacts cheerfully with Julius and the household staff, devoting herself to her vegetable patch and sewing. Julius, who has only known a cold home life, is baffled by her actions. One day, Julius's friend Rebeka invites Elsa to a tea party. There, she learns that Julius's birthday is near, and she starts to plan a surprise party.

episodes.title: Cufflinks and a Music Box
episodes.summary: After the official Sun Festival ceremony, Elsa heads out to join in the festivities at the invitation of her younger brother, Hannes. Julius is unaware of this, so when Serafina tells him that Elsa has headed into town with a man, he instinctively chases after her. Though he thought that theirs was marriage in name only, he realizes that at some point, he has begun to want to trust Elsa.

episodes.title: Behind a Smile
episodes.summary: Elsa hosts a tea party where Serafina says, "Julius forgot this," and hands her one of the cufflinks she'd gifted him. Julius is happy to have it back, but uneasy about the fact that Elsa didn't seem concerned about it. As Julius considers the idea that Elsa doesn't see him as a romantic interest, she's visiting the castle, where Serafina's older brother Jarmo tosses some suggestive words her way.

episodes.title: The Sound of Distant Rain
episodes.summary: Julius and Elsa visit a botanical garden. Julius considers himself adept with women, but for some reason, he struggles to find his footing with Elsa. Though their outing is filled with unfortunate events such as an encounter with Jarmo and getting rained on, Julius feels saved by Elsa's words: "I like listening to the sound of rain." But getting pelted by the rain leaves Julius with a high fever.

episodes.title: The Trap Hidden at the Soirée
episodes.summary: Julius is ordered to infiltrate a soirée hosted by Count Parnilla's family. He asks Elsa to accompany him as his wife. Elsa is nervous about attending her first soirée, but with Rebeka and Hannes's help, she fulfills her role as the wife of a ducal house. Then a very drunk man approaches her, seemingly targeting her the moment she's alone. The truth is that all it's part of Jarmo's scheme.

episodes.title: An Unexpected Gift
episodes.summary: By chance, Julius learns about Elsa' birthday. He says, "I hope you'll let me celebrate it for you," and works desperately to clear his work so he can take Elsa to the opera. The splendid production and Julius's kindness combine to make Elsa's day a very special one. On a different day, while in town, Elsa comes across a rundown church with a children's home that is struggling to make ends meet.

episodes.title: Misunderstandings and Falsehoods
episodes.summary: Elsa has begun teaching at the children's home, but she hasn't been able to tell Julius because he's been busy. Julius manages to finish work early, and when he learns that Elsa is in town, he goes out looking for her, but what he finds is Jarmo chatting happily with Elsa. It is a mere chance meeting between the two, but when Julius sees them, he misunderstands the nature of their relationship.

episodes.title: Jarmo's Vow
episodes.summary: Jarmo dreams of the past, of his wretched life in a children's home, and of his desperate, diligent hard work after being taken in by his adoptive father. However, in spite of that, Julius was always ahead of him. Before long, Jarmo's sense of admiration for Julius began to change... Meanwhile, Elsa hosts a fund-raising bazaar at the children's home.

episodes.title: Julius's Wish
episodes.summary: Elsa accompanies Julius on his business trip. Elsa enjoys spending time with the children at the local lord's house, but her heart aches because of Julius's words, "I have no intention of loving you." That night, the two are given a room to share. Julius spends a sleepless night. The two are considerate of each other but pass each other by. The next day, Yarmo visits them...

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Julius and Elsa visit a spinning mill for an inspection. For some reason, Yarmo accompanies them. While Julius talks with the factory manager, Elsa goes to the warehouse with Yarmo to select threads for decorative cords, and they end up locked inside the warehouse alone. It was all Yarmo's doing. "Is Julius using you?" Yarmo's cunning words leave Elsa feeling conflicted...
